how: Final held-out set (2026-11-11): astro, TanStack Router, traefik, nushell, pydantic, mockito, MudBlazor. Labelled by independent agents from loose candidates (70 per project, fixed seed) plus every claim the engine makes alone and with the Jev/Clef second opinion. Never inspected; scored by totals only.
